purpose: Why do authentic receipts fail arithmetic checks? Manual diagnosis behind ADR-0012.
population: Authentic training receipts on which at least one Phase 2 check (docfraud.reading.consistency.CHECKS) fails, fields read by parser v2 from the dataset transcripts, in the order of the training split
sample: 15 receipts drawn with numpy default_rng(20261007).choice(population size, 15, replace=False); experiments/rules_development.py re-draws them and checks that they match
reviewer: claude (annotator), 2026-10-07; each receipt's parsed fields compared with its transcript

causes.reading_error: parser v2 misread, missed, duplicated or mislabelled an amount or line
causes.rule_gap: the receipt prints a structure the Phase 2 checks did not model

receipts.note: The take-away line's unit price is read as its amount, and the 0.40 next to the tax is not the tax.
Service charge 5.62 lies between the total excluding tax and the total including tax; the check ignores it.
Every item line is read twice (code row and description row), doubling the item sum.
Quantity, price and amount columns are misaligned across lines.
A line total is read as a separate item.
The tax amount is read as the total including tax; the amount due is missing.
The quantity row is read as an item and the totals are mislabelled.
The quantity row is read as an item and the amount due is misread.
The amount excluding tax is labelled as a third amount due.
The taxable amount of the tax summary is read as a second tax amount.
Delivery-note columns are misread, so item lines are missing or wrong.
Unit price and amount columns are swapped on one line.
A total is read as a tax amount and the change is misread.

No subtotal is printed: items 20.90 plus service charge 2.09, tax 1.38 and rounding 0.03 give 24.40, a chain the check did not model; the parser also reads the service charge as tax and misses the tax.
Three different values are labelled as subtotal.
